# Remotion Video Effects

Use this file for all work in this Remotion package.

## Remotion Plugin Rule

- Before changing compositions, render commands, timing, media assets, captions, audio, or `remotion.config.ts`, load the installed Codex Remotion plugin skill: `remotion:remotion-best-practices`.
- Read the plugin rule files that match the change. Common choices here are `rules/compositions.md`, `rules/timing.md`, `rules/animations.md`, `rules/assets.md`, `rules/images.md`, and `rules/videos.md`.
- Keep this package on Remotion for generated marketing video effects. Do not replace composition or render behavior with ad hoc HTML screenshots or browser-only rendering.

## Validation

- For visual behavior changes, run a targeted Remotion render or still check before calling the work complete.
- Use `npm run studio` for preview work and `npm run render` for the default demo render from this folder.
